;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Tigray conflict]]
**[[Asmara rocket attacks]]
***Explosions are reported in the [[Eritrea]]n capital [[Asmara]] amid reports of a missile attack from [[Tigray Region|Tigray]], [[Ethiopia]]. The [[Eritrean government]] confirms missiles were launched at the capital but said that they missed and instead landed in the countryside. The attack comes just hours after the [[Tigray People's Liberation Front]] (TPLF) threatened to target Eritrea. [https://eritreahub.org/missiles-hit-eritrean-capital-asmara-after-tigray-threatens-to-attack-eritrea (Eritrea Hub)]
**The TPLF launched missiles at [[Gondar Airport]] and [[Bahir Dar Airport]] in [[Amhara Region]], [[Ethiopia]]. A spokesman for the TPLF says, "As long as the attacks on the people of Tigray do not stop, the attacks will intensify". [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/11/14/africa/ethiopia-airport-tigray-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**Hundreds of people cross the [[Tekezé River]] on small boats into [[Sudan]], fleeing the escalating fighting in Tigray. There are now around 8,000 [[refugee]]s stranded on the Ethiopia–Sudan border. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-ethiopia-conflict-refugees/fleeing-tigray-war-ethiopians-cross-river-into-sudan-idUKKBN27U0JS?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[2020 Western Saharan clashes]]
**The [[Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic]] declares war on [[Morocco]], formally ending a 29-year truce. [https://www.axios.com/western-sahara-end-independence-truce-morocco-b97f386e-6ca3-45fb-aefe-13656f37f54d.html (Axios)]

;Disasters and accidents 
*[[2020 Pacific typhoon season]]
**Around 468,000 people are to be evacuated in [[Vietnam]] ahead of the landfall of [[Typhoon Vamco (2020)|Typhoon Vamco]], which has already killed 53 people in the [[Philippines]]. [[Prime Minister of Vietnam|Prime Minister]] [[Nguyễn Xuân Phúc]] warns people of the seriousness of the storm. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-asia-storm-philippines/vietnam-braces-for-typhoon-vamco-53-dead-in-philippines-idUSKBN27U06B?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[2020 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Tropical Storm Iota]] strengthens in the [[Caribbean Sea]] and is expected to intensify in the coming hours, threatening many parts of [[Central America]], including [[Belize]], [[Honduras]], [[Nicaragua]], [[Costa Rica]], [[Panama]] and [[Colombia]]. The storm is expected to grow into a hurricane. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/11/14/weather/iota-storm-saturday/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Piatra Neamț hospital fire]]
**A fire breaks out in a hospital in [[Piatra Neamț]], [[Romania]], killing at least 10 people. [https://www.digi24.ro/stiri/actualitate/evenimente/7-pacienti-decedati-dupa-un-incendiu-violent-la-sectia-ati-de-la-spitalul-judetean-piatra-neamt-1401850 (Digi24)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alberta]]
*****[[Alberta]] reports 1,026 new cases, a new single-day record since the [[pandemic]] began. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/edmonton/alberta-covid-new-cases-1.5802620 (CBC)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Manitoba]]
*****[[Manitoba]] reports a record 15 new fatalities, including 11 deaths that are linked to Maples Long Term Care Home in [[Winnipeg]], bringing the death toll to 152. [https://winnipeg.ctvnews.ca/15-covid-19-deaths-reported-saturday-a-new-record-for-manitoba-1.5189152 (CKY-DT)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Ontario]] reports a new single-day record of 1,581 cases, bringing the total number of cases in the province to 92,761. [http://globalnews.ca/news/7462926/ontario-coronavirus-cases-nov-14-covid19/ (Global News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec]]
*****[[Quebec]] reports a new single-day record of 1,448 cases, bringing the total number of cases in the province to 122,634. [https://montrealgazette.com/news/quebec-reports-1448-new-coronavirus-cases-a-record-one-day-high (''Montreal Gazette'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saskatchewan]]
*****[[Saskatchewan]] reports a new single-day record of 308 cases, bringing the total number of cases in the province to 1,691. [https://regina.ctvnews.ca/sask-shatters-single-day-record-with-308-new-covid-19-cases-1.5189189 (CKCK-DT)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Minnesota]]
*****[[Minnesota]] reports 8,703 new cases, a new single-day record as seven-day positivity rate reaches 15 percent. [https://www.mprnews.org/story/2020/11/14/latest-on-covid-in-mn (Minnesota Public Radio)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Jersey]]
*****[[New Jersey]] reports a new single-day record of 4,395 new cases, surpassing the previous record set in April during the first wave of the pandemic. [https://www.nj.com/coronavirus/2020/11/nj-hits-record-number-of-new-covid-19-cases-with-4395-positive-tests-26-deaths.html (NJ.com)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in North Dakota]]
*****[[North Dakota]] reports 2,278 new cases, a new single day record. [https://www.valleynewslive.com/2020/11/14/2278-cases-of-covid-19-reported-in-north-dakota-new-single-day-high/ (KVLY-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington (state)|COVID-19 pandemic in Washington]]
*****[[Washington (state)|Washington state]] reports 2,323 new cases in the past 24 hours, a single-day record since the start of the pandemic. [https://komonews.com/news/coronavirus/washington-state-adds-record-high-2233-covid-19-cases-in-one-day (KOMO-TV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
****[[Mexico]] surpasses one million cases of COVID-19. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/mexico-reaches-million-virus-cases-nears-100000-deaths-74214410 (ABC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Chancellor of Austria|Chancellor]] [[Sebastian Kurz]] announces a two-week national [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] effective November 17. All schools, non-essential services and shops will be closed, and people will be told not to meet anyone from outside their household as the number of cases continues to rise. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-54945400 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****Education Minister [[Niki Kerameus]] announces the closure of kindergartens, primary schools, and childcare centers across the country for two weeks beginning November 16 as part of tightened [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] measures aimed to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/259169/article/ekathimerini/news/primary-pre-school-facilities-on-lockdown (''Ekathimerini'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] surpasses 10,000 deaths from COVID-19 after a record 548 new deaths are reported in the last 24 hours. [https://www.rmf24.pl/raporty/raport-koronawirus-z-chin/polska/news-najgorszy-bilans-zgonow-od-poczatku-pandemii-w-polsce-548-os,nId,4854918 (RMF 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record 22,702 new cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total since the start of the pandemic to 1.9 million cases. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/11/14/russia-breaks-one-day-coronavirus-record-with-22k-infections-a72046 (''The Moscow Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] reports a record 12,524 new confirmed cases, bringing the nationwide total since the start of the pandemic to 525,176 cases. [https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/covid-19-in-ukraine-12524-new-cases-191-new-deaths-276857-active-cases.html?cn-reloaded=1 (''Kyiv Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****The [[Government of Iran|government]] announces that [[Iran]] will impose stricter restrictions beginning November 21. In [[Tehran]] and about 100 other towns and cities which are classified as "red zone" or "Level 3", non-essential businesses will close and [[car]]s will not be allowed to enter or leave the city. [https://en.irna.ir/news/84109477/Rouhani-New-COVID19-restrictions-to-be-placed-as-of-Nov-21 (IRNA)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/instant-article/idUSKBN27U0EA (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] reports 1,731 new confirmed cases, a new record for the third consecutive day, as many prefectures such as [[Osaka Prefecture|Osaka]] and [[Chiba Prefecture|Chiba]] report record numbers of daily cases. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2020/11/3bceb1125a15-japanese-people-more-cautious-but-continue-to-travel-amid-virus-surge.html (Kyodo News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports 205 new confirmed cases, exceeding 200 for the first time since September, according to data from the [[Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency]]. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20201114000951320?section=national/national (Yonhap News Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]], [[travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
***[[Western Australia]] reopens its hard border for the first time in seven months after it was closed due to restrictions related to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-11-14/wa-border-opens-travellers-stream-over-the-border-coronavirus/12881548 (ABC Australia)]

;International relations
*[[Foreign relations of the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic]]
**[[Guyana]] withdraws its recognition of the [[Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic]] (SADR) following the military [[2020 Western Saharan clashes|clashes]] in [[Guerguerat]]. Guyana's Foreign Minister [[Hugh Todd]] says his country will "support the efforts of the [[United Nations]] to achieve a peaceful and mutually acceptable solution". [https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2020/11/325972/guyana-withdraws-recognition-of-polisarios-self-proclaimed-sadr/ (Morocco World News)]
